question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Keep someone in the loop
solution:
The correct answer is **'Give them all the information.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• 
 The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom 'Keep someone in the loop' is 'Give them all the information.'
 
 
• 
 **Keep someone in the loop:** to keep them informed/updated on a plan. (उन्हें एक योजना पर सूचित/अद्यतन रखने के लिए।)

 
 
• 
 **For example**, *Seth asks John to keep him in the loop about Marty's party.*
 
 
 
 
• 
 ​Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, option **3** is correct.
